changes: Persons, relations, date (ŚS 1809 = c. 1887 CE) and place all check out and are kept as they were.
Added a note: the colophon gives the work as Brahmāṇḍottarapurāṇa (Lalitopākhyāna, Nyāsavidhi, vilāsa 5), not Skandapurāṇa as the catalogue title says.
Added a note on the obscure closing word 'lagītamohatakā(!)': it may be a Nepali or Newari phrase, perhaps about cost or paper, and is not a personal name.

notes: The colophon gives the text as śrībrahmāṇḍottarapurāṇa, Hayagrīva–Agastya dialogue, Lalitopākhyāna, Nyāsavidhi, vilāsa 5, which differs from the catalogue title 'Skandapurāṇa'. The date 'sāke 1809' matches the catalogue (ŚS 1809, about 1887 CE). The colophon has no scribe or other person: it says only 'likhitaṃ'. The final 'lagītamohatakā(!)', after granthasaṃkhyā 3622, is corrupt and unclear. It may be a vernacular note, perhaps about cost ('mohara'?), and does not reliably identify any person.
